ROOT.functiondef: CREATE FUNCTION CDN.PlanowanaIlosc (@Plan int,@DataOd int,@DataDo int) RETURNS TABLE as return select Okres, PLE_TwrTyp as TwrTyp, PLE_TwrNumer as TwrNumer, sum(PLE_Ilosc * (case when PLO_OkresDo<OkresDo or OkresDo=0 then PLO_OkresDo else OkresDo end +1 - case when PLO_OkresOd>OkresOd then PLO_OkresOd else OkresOd end)/ (PLO_OkresDo-PLO_OkresOd+1)) as Ilosc from CDN.PlanElem E inner join CDN.PlanOkres on PLO_Id=PLE_Okres inner join CDN.PlanNag on PLN_Id=PLE_Plan cross join ( select PLO_Id Okres, PLO_OkresOd OkresOd, PLO_OkresDo OkresDo from CDN.PlanOkres where PLO_Plan=@Plan union select 0, @DataOd, @DataDo where @DataOd is not null and @DataDo is not null ) as Okresy where PLN_Stan>0 and (PLO_OkresOd<=OkresDo or OkresDo=0) and OkresOd<=PLO_OkresDo and (isnull(@Plan,0)=0 or (PLE_Plan in ( select PLN_Id from CDN.PlanNag where PLN_Stan>0 and PLN_PlanZrodlowy=(select PLN_PlanZrodlowy from CDN.PlanNag where PLN_Id=@Plan) ) and ( exists(select * from CDN.PlanElem P where P.PLE_Plan=@Plan and E.PLE_TwrTyp=P.PLE_TwrTyp and E.PLE_TwrNumer=P.PLE_TwrNumer) or not exists(select * from CDN.PlanElem where PLE_Plan=@Plan) ) ) ) group by Okres, PLE_TwrTyp, PLE_TwrNumer
